name: Jasmine Boyd
life: “I still remember hearing somebody laugh at the sound of a stopwatch.” People around Maré Coffee know Jasmine by a small Monday habit. Jasmine likes the table where people coming off shift stop checking the time.
voice: I borrowed a stopwatch to prove a point and found our client has a wonderful laugh at minute thirteen.
appearance: Jasmine is easy to recognize by a dark undercut with a longer wave on top and a scattering of freckles across the bridge of the nose. Usually dressed in a cropped bottle-green coat with a thin silver ring worn on a cord, Jasmine looks down for a moment before saying something difficult when listening.
personality: Jasmine has a strong competitive streak and a very soft spot for the person finishing last. A prize tastes better when everybody had enough time to enter.
agenda: To record the ordinary conversation as part of care.
family: Teresa Nielsen is Jasmine’s second cousin. Jasmine chooses whether they walk home or sit a while. Teresa brings a spare shopping bag. That small arrangement gives both a reason to see each other on weeks when asking for company outright feels difficult. Asked about *Low water music*, Teresa says, “My mother called it the kettle. I want to hear her recorded laugh alongside whatever name wins.”
connections: Jody Ito. The stopwatch and the billing software meet a person who laughs at minute thirteen.

reactions.situation: A client wants another minute to finish a button
reactions.response: Jasmine lets the client finish the button and asks where time can be saved without hurrying them.
reactions.asWritten: A client wants another minute to finish a button. Jasmine lets the client finish the button and asks where time can be saved without hurrying them.

reactions.situation: The last bus leaves while an elderly stranger is still crossing toward it
reactions.response: Jasmine asks the stranger who will be expecting them, then helps find a way to tell that person.

reactions.response: Jasmine explains exactly what help was offered and offers the same practical help to the accuser.
reactions.asWritten: If accused of favoritism, Jasmine explains exactly what help was offered and offers the same practical help to the accuser.
